title: Automatic Resource Cleanup
goal: Clear a shared buffer automatically using an RAII guard struct.
hints: Implementing Drop allows a struct to run cleanup logic automatically when it goes out of scope.
Borrowing the String mutably avoids allocating or copying heap data.
explanation: The RAII guard pattern implements `Drop` to run cleanup logic automatically when the guard goes out of scope. This requires zero heap allocations or clones. Cloning strings to handle temporary state incurs extra allocations and unnecessary heap copies, and failing to clear the input buffer directly leaves old data around.
